note: Phase 3 plan. Batches are assigned by style order, then by priority; gated families wait for their gate. Estimates are planning numbers only.

order.reason: Mostly existing assets; refining it proves the manifest pipeline, golden frames and the registry on a working style.
Exists in Canvas; the GPU port and saliency are small and keep a familiar look alive during migration.
Replaces Code screens (most used Turbo look); builds app kits and the camera grammar many styles reuse.
Replaces ASCII eye; builds the character-cell pass shared with Signage.
Replaces Type as Rhythm and Graphic; low asset cost, mostly configuration; builds the beat choreography system.
Replaces Broadsheet and Art Book; typographic, builds the layout solver used by Panels and Cover Pop.
Replaces Velvet, Nocturne (direction) and Stillness; small asset set; builds bokeh and weather layers reused by Signage.
Replaces Analog Cinema; builds the film stock and grain profiles.
Needs the character-cell pass (Glyph Cinema) and weather (Nocturne).
Large handcrafted set; needs the parallax layer system.
Largest illustration family; needs the layout and balloon solvers.
After its stroke-reveal spike (INK-G1); owner paints elements.
Last; only if MON-G1 passes. Otherwise the reserve Riso Riot is specified and produced in this slot.

infrastructure.name: Unified style registry
infrastructure.objective: One list of 15 styles with GPU tier and Canvas 2D fallback (or GPU only), replacing Clean vs Turbo; stored-pick migration map (decisions.md).
infrastructure.done: Registry merged behind a flag; old picks map to new styles; tests pass.

infrastructure.name: Golden frames (T1)
infrastructure.objective: Visual regression on fixed frames per style and per test-matrix row.
infrastructure.done: Golden frame runner in CI with a tolerance; first goldens for Sketch Cards.

infrastructure.name: Flash guard (V5)
infrastructure.objective: Photosensitivity guard applied to every style's output (luminance change and red flash limits).
infrastructure.done: Guard on by default; test with synthetic strobe input.

infrastructure.name: Estimated-timing soft mode (P4)
infrastructure.objective: Styles receive timing confidence and switch to line-level reveals when words are estimated.
infrastructure.done: All styles read confidence; tests for authored, estimated and none.

infrastructure.name: Scene-family runtime
infrastructure.objective: Shared schema: style > scene families > composition families > assets; deterministic selection and repetition windows (scene-composition-system.md).
infrastructure.done: Selection is pure and tested for determinism and repetition limits.

infrastructure.name: Asset pipeline and manifest loader
infrastructure.objective: Build step that validates manifests, converts SVG to path data and textures to KTX2, and lazy-loads per style.
infrastructure.done: Pipeline validates the JSON schema and fails on missing assets.

infrastructure.name: Typography infrastructure
infrastructure.objective: Per-style font loading with script coverage, fallback chain and payload budget (V14).
infrastructure.done: Font loader with budgets; script detection routes runs to faces.

infrastructure.name: Warm-up and prefetch (P5)
infrastructure.objective: Compile shaders and paint sheets ahead of need.
infrastructure.done: No first-use hitch above 50 ms in the bench.

infrastructure.name: Per-style quality steps (V7)
infrastructure.objective: Governor steps per style (resolution, effects off).
infrastructure.done: Every style declares its steps; bench shows recovery.

infrastructure.name: Reduced-motion contract
infrastructure.objective: Every style implements its reduced-motion rules from motion.md.
infrastructure.done: Reduced-motion golden frames for each style.

gates.question: Readable façade text while moving; 60 fps at 1080p on an integrated GPU with a 40-line city; Devanagari and Tamil via sprite stack.
gates.fail: Replace Monument with Riso Riot (owner approves).
gates.when: First spike, before any Monument asset.

gates.question: Skeleton-based stroke reveal looks intentional on 4 scripts and costs under 6 ms per line.
gates.fail: Keep only the generic reading-direction wipe.

gates.question: Calligram routing reads as intended, not noise.
gates.fail: Drop calligram compositions; keep subject passes.
gates.applies_to: GLY-CMP-C2 Calligram and the scene families that list it; they ship only after the gate (GLY-B1 acceptance).

gates.question: Hershey licence verified; outline-trace readability for Devanagari, Tamil and Arabic by native readers.
gates.fail: Declared fallback (underline sweep with Noto Sans glow) for failing scripts.

gates.question: Deterministic fluid that does not look like a generic shader.
gates.applies_to: LLS fluid presets (LLS-B1 acceptance includes the gate).
